bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) exit 51;; esac
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
sha="faaae3e88c99a7cdfa85a70c91b6b585e3cd7a0d"
test "$(git -C "$root/.worktrees/creator-entry-faaae3e" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 52
newtag="create-videobot:creator-entry-faaae3e"
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$newtag")"
alias="create-videobot:creator-entry-live-base-faaae3e"
baseid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$alias")"
ids="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | grep -c .)" -eq 1 || exit 53
before="$ids"
runningid="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$before")"
if test "$runningid" = "$newid"; then
 echo CREATOR_EDITOR_ALREADY_DEPLOYED=PASS
 exit 0
fi
test "$runningid" = "$baseid" || { echo CREATOR_LIVE_VERSION_CHANGED_AGAIN; exit 54; }
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$before")"
files="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' "$before")"
base="$(printf '%s' "$files" | cut -d, -f1)"
case "$base" in *compose.videobot.poll.yaml) ;; *) echo CREATOR_UNEXPECTED_COMPOSE; exit 55;; esac
test -f "$base" || exit 56
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" config --quiet || exit 57
overrides="$root/.worktrees/creator-entry-deploy-overrides-faaae3e"
mkdir -p "$overrides"
cat > "$overrides/live.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  videobot-poll:
    image: create-videobot:creator-entry-faaae3e
YAML
cat > "$overrides/rollback.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  videobot-poll:
    image: create-videobot:creator-entry-live-base-faaae3e
YAML
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$overrides/live.yaml" config --quiet || exit 58
changed=0
rollback() {
 rc=$?
 trap - ERR
 set +e
 if test "$changed" = 1; then
  docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$overrides/rollback.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps videobot-poll >/dev/null
  echo CREATOR_EDITOR_ROLLBACK_ATTEMPTED
 fi
 exit "$rc"
}
trap rollback ERR
changed=1
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$overrides/live.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps videobot-poll
sleep 8
ids2="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$project" --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$ids2" | grep -c .)" -eq 1 || { echo CREATOR_EDITOR_POLLER_COUNT_INVALID; false; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$ids2")" = "$newid" || { echo CREATOR_EDITOR_IMAGE_MISMATCH; false; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$ids2")" = true || { echo CREATOR_EDITOR_NOT_RUNNING; false; }
trap - ERR
echo CREATOR_EDITOR_DIRECT_LINK_RUNTIME=PASS
echo CREATOR_EDITOR_POLLER_COUNT=1
echo CREATOR_EDITOR_SOURCE_SHA="$sha"
